_comment: Ratchets for npm run check. Numbers may only go down. Targets from docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-19-app-refactor.md: 600 lines per file, 80 lines per function, 0 unreachable functions.

_notes.src/app.js: Task 6 walked this down 6210 -> 157: theme/i18n/reference, core/dom.mjs, core/markdown.mjs, core/routes.mjs, then the screens in 6.5-6.8, then 6.9's components/auth-modal.mjs and core/router.mjs. What is left is bootstrap. Went 157 -> 160 for the stale-locale-chrome fix: an import, a comment and an onLocaleChange registration, which is the smallest form that fix takes. Bugfixes may cost a line; drift may not.
_notes.src/screens/saved-roster.mjs: Task 7b folded this file's shared markup into components/roster-editor/*: the table, the staff steppers, the identity panel, the staff lines. 1219 -> 1138. What is left is what a team already in play has and a new one does not — SPP, advancements, contracts, the phone cards, the wiring and the save plumbing — and only step 7b.4 moves that. The five lines back from 1133 are task 4.7's conflict handling, which is a data-loss fix: without them a coach whose team was saved in another tab sees a status line and no way to choose.
_notes.src/screens/builder.mjs: wireBuilder() came in at 100 lines, moved from app.js unchanged. Same task-7 note as saved-roster.mjs: this shrinks when the two editors merge.
_notes.scripts/backup/status.mjs: Arrived with the nightly-backup work on main, which was written before this branch's check-structure existed and so never ran against it. evaluateSystemdState() is 108 lines. Inherited, not drift — lower it when that file is next touched.
_notes.server/server.mjs: Step 4.9 split this file. Out: response plumbing (http/responses.mjs), the pool (db/pool.mjs), env loading (config/env.mjs, so a module reading process.env at import time sees a populated one), row serializers (api/serializers.mjs), sessions (auth/session.mjs), the season (season/{scoring,store,rounds,games}.mjs) and the auth and team routes (routes/*.mjs). 1935 -> 663. What is left of handleApi is the admin, season and game endpoints; they move next, and the file goes under 600 with them. handleApi() itself is still 479 lines against a limit of 80 — that is the remaining half of the step, and the number to watch: it was 672.
_notes.server/season/games.mjs: updateSeasonPairing() is 95 lines. Not new debt — it was always this long, hidden by the 700-line function override server.mjs carried while everything lived there. Step 4.9 only made it visible. Task 14.2 rewrites this function to confirm a result in one transaction instead of two statements; it shrinks then, not before.
_notes.server/season/rounds.mjs: generateSwissRound() is 88 lines, and inherited the same way. Task 14.5 replaces its greedy pairing pass — which takes the first opponent available and then any opponent at all, so it can invent a rematch where a consistent pairing existed — with a search. Lower it there.
